title: UnitOfMeasure - Data API
description: Defines the units and systems of units used to express and account for quantities. This object is available in API version 61.0 and later.

ConversionFactor.description: The factor or rate that's used to convert this unit of measurement to the base unit. For example, for the Weight unit of measure class, the default unit of measure is pounds (lbs). Then, all units of measure records with the Weight unit of measure class are converted to equate 1 unit to 1 pound. If the unit of measure is kilogram, the conversion factor is 2.2 as 1 pound consists of 2.2 kilograms.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of this unit of measure.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the unit of measure.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user or group that owns the job., This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Type.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
Type.description: The type of the unit of measure. For example, weight, distance, period.

Sequence.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Sequence.description: The sequence number assigned to the unit of measure.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Specifies the status of the unit of measure. Possible values are: Active Draft Inactive

UnitCode.description: Code for the unit of measure.

UnitOfMeasureClassId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UnitOfMeasureClassId.description: The class associated with the unit of measurement. This field is a relationship field.
